root_causes.root_cause: RFC-034 D7 replaced the non-functional _word_has_reversed_morphology (presentation-form check with 0% TPR after NFKC normalization) with a functional joining-type-based check (_arabic_word_joins). This makes the morphological_reversal prong in _tree_is_rtl_reversed actually fire on NFKC-normalized Arabic text. For ward-597 — a document with a known corrupt numeric-junk text layer where Docling emits no full-page Picture region for Arabic body pages (RFC-028 D5 residual gap) — the newly functional detector correctly identifies RTL reversal. The repair path (reconstruct_bidi_order) fails to converge because the underlying text is too damaged (near-zero Arabic chars, all numeric junk), and the RFC-033 D8 flat-path fallback also cannot recover non-reversed content. The gate correctly rejects the document as ERROR. This is a TRUE POSITIVE — the document was always corrupt; the gate was previously blind to it (0% TPR). The comparison doc سياسة حوكمة is NOT caught by _tree_is_rtl_reversed because its corruption pattern (single-letter Arabic fragments) is different from ward-597's (numeric-junk with reversed morphology); سياسة حوكمة's gate blind spot persists as a separate known issue (RFC-034 D21/RFC-033 D2 Part B).
root_causes.suggested_fix: No code fix needed for the gate itself — the D7 change is correct and the rejection is a true positive. The underlying issue is that ward-597 needs a full-page OCR fallback for scanned Arabic pages where Docling detects no Picture region (RFC-028 D5 out-of-scope residual). Until that is implemented, this document will remain at ERROR. If the goal is to recover it: implement a page-level OCR escalation path that rasterizes and OCR's full pages when no Picture region covers the Arabic body text (medium-large effort, tracked as a known gap since RFC-028).
